## 原文
Title: fix(openai): ChatGPT-only model list offers unlisted pro models that …

Article:
fix(openai): ChatGPT-only model list offers unlisted pro models that fail (#167975)

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: for a user signed in with only a ChatGPT account, the default model list offers `openai/gpt-5.4-pro` and `openai/gpt-5.5-pro` even though that account s model listing doesn t include them, so choosing either one fails.

## User Impact

ChatGPT-only users stop seeing these two models in the default model view (TUI and the Gateway `models.list` default view). Models the account lists stay, and so do hidden rows the account is entitled to, such as `gpt-5.5`. A user who also has an OpenAI API key still sees both pro models.

## Why This Change Was Made

- A successful ChatGPT account listing now records every model id it returned, hidden rows included, as private `listedModelIds` on the ready provider outcome. The public `providerOutcomes` projection still carries only provider, profile and status.
- The picker s availability check uses that list. A model served both by an API key and by ChatGPT, but missing from the account s listing, can t be used through the ChatGPT account. It stays available only

## 原文
Title: test(qa-lab): quota-reset e2e fails when chat.history races agent dat…

Article:
test(qa-lab): quota-reset e2e fails when chat.history races agent database creation (#168106)

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: `test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/quota-reset.e2e.test.ts` fails on `main` (8 of 9 cases) with `GatewayClientRequestError: Session access facts are unavailable; retry after session storage is ready.` (`UNAVAILABLE` on `chat.history`, `retryable: true`, `retryAfterMs: 250`). CI only runs this suite when its files change, so `main` CI stays green.

## User Impact

No user-visible change. The quota-reset e2e suite is green again, so PRs that touch it (for example #168033) are not blocked by a failure that is already on `main`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The failure is a gap in the test fixture, not a product bug. Each fixture boots a fresh Gateway with no agent database yet (startup logs `registeredDatabaseCount=0`). The first agent write creates `agents/main/agent/openclaw-agent.sqlite` shortly after the Gateway reports ready. The fixture s first `turn()` calls `chat.history` for a session that doesn t exist yet. When that read lands in the creation window, it fails like this:

- `chat.history` prepares negative-read facts for the absent row (`src/gateway/server-methods/chat-history-session-read.ts:178-186`). That captures the agent store as missing (`src/gateway/session-sharing-preparation.ts:324-338`).
- Creating the store publishes an agent-database registry change. `assertRegistryPublication` then sees the path go from missing to a real file (`src/gateway/session-sharing-preparation.ts:197-210`, `441-456`) and invalidates the facts.
- The handler sends back the documented retryable refusal (`chat-history-session-read.ts:335-339`, `chat-history-recovery.ts:37-50`).

This refusal is intentional. A store that appears mid-read could hold the row the read just reported as absent. Real clients already retry it: the Control UI retries `UNAVAILABLE`/`retryable` history reads for 60s (`ui/src/pages/chat/chat-history-retry.ts:7-32`), and `gateway-rpc-chat.e2e.test.ts` does the same in its history helper. Only the quota fixture issued one-shot `chat.history` calls, so whether a case passed depended on whether the store already existed when the first read arrived. In the instrumented run, the passing case created the store 1.2s before its first read. The failing case created it 300ms after.

The fixture s `turn()` now reads history through `readHistory`. It retries only `UNAVAILABLE` + `retryable` refusals whose `details.method` is `chat.history`, honors `retryAfterMs`, gives up after 60s (the same window as the Control UI), and records each retry in the case evidence. Every other error still fails at once. No assertions, timeouts, or cases changed.

I didn t pin the commit that opened the race. The run is 8 of 9 bad from `e39552c1810`, 9 of 9 good at `16aa5e11ff7`/`a282f8002a3`. A full bisect wasn t needed to choose the fix.

## Evidence

- Red on `main` (`0484b1373e4`): `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs --config test/vitest/vitest.e2e.config.ts test/e2e/qa-lab/runtime/quota-reset.e2e.test.ts` → `Tests 8 failed | 1 passed (9)`. All 8 fail with the `chat.history` `UNAVAILABLE` error above.
- Root cause from temporary instrumentation of the built Gateway (removed afterward): the throw comes from `assertPaths` inside `assertRegistryPublication`, called from the `sessionChanges` facts listener. The captured identity was `path:…/agents/main/agent/openclaw-agent.sqlite` (missing) and the current one was `file:…` with a birthtime. The registry change came from the first agent writer s `registerOpenClawAgentDatabase`, 300ms after the case s first `chat.history`.
- Green with this change: same command → `Tests 9 passed (9)`.
- `quota-reset.isolated.e2e.test.ts` (shares the fixture): `Tests 2 passed (2)`
- `pnpm exec oxlint --type-aware` on the changed file: clean. `oxfmt --check`: clean. `node scripts/check-changed.mjs`: passed, including the dead-export scan.

Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi  hi@obviy.us

## 原文
Title: 2026-10-12 Hacker News Top Stories

Article:
2026-10-12 Hacker News Top Stories
  
#

Cloudflare Radar 显示，Yandex 的 AS13238 近七日请求约 99.6% 被分类为自动流量，曲线在 10 月 11 日附近骤降；数据范围仅限该网络来源。

Yandex 在 Vladimir 的数据中心据报道停运，继 Ryazan、Kaluga 之后成为第三起近期事件；官方状态页受验证码阻挡，损害范围与恢复时间仍未核验。

Oliver Sin 的 Discretionary Review 模拟 2015—2031 年旧金山建房，玩家须通过审查、听证、诉讼与融资考验；法规和案例取自公开记录，经济与社区政治经过简化。

教程用 Qwen3-1.7B 限制单次输出为五个选项，CommonsenseQA 示例准确率从 59.38% 微调至 62.41%；作者强调 token 概率必须校准，不能直接当作答案正确率。

Nitter 10 月 10 日公告称 X 曾两次要求关闭实例与仓库，维护者撤回此前已有法律代表的说法，表示目前没有法律顾问，正在寻求援助。

LineageOS 24 基于 Android 17，加入 Canvas 图像编辑器和 WebUSB 刷机工具；Linux 4.4、4.9 设备继续留在 22.2，新版支持范围取决于设备与维护者。

Inside Climate News 梳理马萨诸塞州诉讼中新公开的 ExxonMobil 文件，包括对藻类燃料日产一万桶目标的内部否定，以及碳捕集宣传与技术规模之间的分歧。

Terence Eden 为 ActivityBot 支付每小时 25 欧元、总计约 150 欧元，请真人共享屏幕并边操作边说，逐轮修正 README 中的隐含前提和步骤问题。

IRCv3 在保留旧客户端兼容性的基础上扩展认证、消息标签与时间戳，历史、注册等能力仍有草案或实现差异；它是持续演进的客户端协议工作，不是一次统一升级。

Piotr Sarnacki 分析 Campfire 的 AI 改写：把 Rust 队列从 256 扩到 16,384 后，百次每秒测试的通知交付约从 14% 升至 90%，但最大延迟从 11 秒升到逾 130 秒。

  1. Yandex 网络来源的自动流量明显下降 (Bot traffic from Yandex)
  
#

  
https://radar.cloudflare.com/bots/as13238?dateRange=7d

这条投稿链接到 Cloudflare Radar 的动态图表，观察对象是 AS13238（YANDEX — Yandex LLC）发出的流量。近七日窗口中，页面显示约 99.6% 的请求被分类为自动流量、0.4% 为人类流量。机器人请求曲线在 10 月 7 日附近先下降一档，10 月 11 日附近又接近归一化坐标的底部，随后出现小幅回升；图表同时展示前七日对照。

Cloudflare 的说明将机器人识别建立在 bot score 上：1—29 分归为可能自动化，30 分及以上归为可能人类；默认的人机比例针对 HTML 请求，排除 API、图片、脚本等类型。流量趋势使用归一化展示，因此坐标接近零不能直接换算成某个绝对请求数量或精确下降百分比。

这页能说明来自特定 ASN、被 Cloudflare 观察到的请求发生了变化，不能独自解释原因。搜索引擎爬虫、云平台程序等都可能产生自动请求；图表没有证明这些流量属于宣传、诈骗或攻击，也不能据此推断俄罗斯乃至全球的机器人活动整体减少。数据中心事件与曲线变化的因果关系仍需其他资料核实。

  HN 热度 585 points | 评论 238 comments | 投稿者：walrus01 | 发布时间：2026-10-11 18:27:53 +08:00
  
#

  
https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50041619

多位参与者提醒，这张图针对 Yandex 的单个 ASN，不能当作俄罗斯或全球机器人流量的总趋势。

搜索引擎本来就需要爬虫，自动流量下降并不自动意味着恶意机器人减少。

也有回复指出 Yandex 运营云服务，因此来自其网络的自动请求可能包含租户

rows.title: He Waited Nine Years in Prison for His Lawyer to File a Single Brief. In This State, There’s No Rule Against It.
rows.translated_content:
## 原文
标题：他在狱中苦等九年，律师才递交一份法律文件。而这个州，竟没有禁止这一行为的规则

文章：
马克·哈里斯为ProPublica撰写。图片来源：亚历杭德罗·A·阿尔瓦雷斯/《费城询问者报》，经帕特里克·希克森提供，法院记录。

2020年，在被指派为一名声称被错误定罪的当事人提供代理七年之后，律师斯科特·加洛韦告诉法官，他仍在调查此案，需要更多时间。

"我仍在采访相关人员的过程中，"这位律师写给费城郊外的特拉华县法官，该法官已批准他延期32次。

他的当事人诺兰·奥尼尔在被切斯特警方以谋杀罪逮捕时，是一名20岁的高中生，警方有四位目击证人指认了他。在2005年的审判中，这些证人都撤回了指控，称警方施压让他们指控奥尼尔。

到加洛韦2013年加入该案时，奥尼尔已经在监狱中度过了八年，坚称自己无罪。律师的任务是帮助他根据宾夕法尼亚州《定罪后救济法》提交请愿书。如果加洛韦能找到关键新证据，或证明之前的律师在处理案件时出现失误，该法律提供了一条通往自由的狭窄途径。

但法院记录并未显示这位律师除了申请更多时间外，还做了其他事情。

2022年，在九年后、一次获取证据的尝试失败以及41次延期之后，加洛韦提交了一份仅两页的请愿书，只涉及奥尼尔希望提出的众多问题中的一个。这不足以让
